title: Crispy Shrimp Fajitas
description: Quick and flavorful fajitas with crispy shrimp, bell peppers, onions, and a hint of Mexican spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced bell peppers and onions to the skillet.
Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, and Mexican seasoning to the skillet.
Return the shrimp to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and spices.
Serve the shrimp and vegetables in the tortillas and enjoy!
Optional: Add your favorite toppings such as avocado, sour cream, or salsa.
